title: Delicious Kicked Up Turkish Chicken Kebabs
description: A flavorful twist on traditional Turkish kebabs, featuring tender chicken and a kick of spice.
instructions: Thread chicken, onion, and red bell pepper onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, kicked up spice blend, salt, and pepper.
Brush the spice mixture onto both sides of the chicken.
Place the kebabs on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Meanwhile, mix together lemon juice and garlic in a small bowl.
Brush the lemon mixture onto the kebabs during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Serve hot with a side of Turkish salad or rice pilaf.
Note: For kicked up spice blend, combine 1 tablespoon smoked paprika, 1 tablespoon ground cumin, 1 tablespoon brown sugar, 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper, and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a small bowl.
